prompt: Which PI components did Ence use for its control-loop monitoring and diagnostics tool?

PI DataLink spreadsheets only
PI Batch and PI ProcessBook

prompt: Which PI use case at Sappi's Somerset mill matches this?
scenario: A paper mill has its own boiler. Grid power prices change, and the mill must choose between buying more grid electricity and raising steam production on site.

options.text: Use PI data to decide whether to buy grid energy or raise boiler steam, balancing generated and purchased power
Shut the boiler whenever grid power is available
Run the boiler at maximum all the time
Report energy only once a year

explanation: Sappi's Somerset mill uses PI System to decide whether to buy more grid energy or raise steam production in its own boiler.

prompt: How should you quote this outcome?
scenario: The Ence success story gives an energy saving as "1,500 MWh saved per pulp mill" in one place and "1,500 MWs per hour per year" in the body text.

options.text: Quote "1,500 MWh saved per pulp mill", reported by AVEVA, and note that the page is inconsistent
Quote "1,500 MWs per hour per year" because it is in the body
Average the two and say 1,500 MW
Convert both to GJ and combine them

explanation: "MWs per hour per year" is not a valid unit, so the page is inconsistent. Quote the clear version exactly, say AVEVA reported it, and note the inconsistency. Never convert or combine.

prompt: Pulp production is measured in air-dry ______ (ADt).
explanation: The air-dry tonne is the standard pulp production unit. Klabin reported production up 3,400 air-dry tons per year.

prompt: Which outcomes does the Ence success story report? Select all that apply.

options.text: 15% emissions reduction (pulp mills)
Summer water-shortage downtime from 15 days to zero
€150,000/year biomass savings
Nearly 900 manual interventions avoided per day

explanation: The first four are Ence figures. Maintenance costs cut by nearly $10 million is Klabin.

prompt: How many variables does Klabin's integrator say the PI System keeps in one place?

options.text: 1 million

explanation: The integrator says "we have 85,000 variables of the various integration systems, and the PI System keeps it all in one place". 25,000+ is the number of assets; 3,400 is the extra air-dry tons per year.

prompt: True or false: Ence publishes AF-contextualised water-usage data to CONNECT, where deep-learning models predict river flow.
